services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Minor leaks through major storm damage, inspected first.
services.text: Our team addresses all roof repair solutions you need, from minor leaks to major storm damage, starting with a thorough inspection.
services.imageAlt: A roofer lifting damaged shingles to reach a leak
body: We start by doing a thorough inspection and applying excellent repairs to make sure your roof is in good condition. A professional roof inspection is what tells us whether a repair is the right answer: isolated leaks and damaged shingles usually call for repairs, while widespread damage, multiple leaks or a roof aging past 20 years typically warrants replacement.
Most repairs are completed in hours. Repairs carry a 1-year warranty.

Residential roof repairs in Houston run $3 to $7 per square foot, depending on materials and the severity of the damage; roof type, slope and accessibility move the number too. We offer same-day residential roof repairs and 24/7 emergency availability, and we repair storm and wind damage, broken shingles, leaks, and flashing around chimneys, vents and skylights.
points: Flashing and vent repairs around chimneys and skylights
Honest assessment of repair against replacement
Repairs run $3 to $7 per square foot

faqs.q: How do I know if I need a roof repair or full replacement?
faqs.a: A professional roof inspection is essential to determine the right solution. Minor issues like isolated leaks or damaged shingles often require repairs, while widespread damage, multiple leaks, aging beyond 20 years, or extensive storm damage typically warrant replacement.

faqs.q: How long does a repair take?
faqs.a: Repairs are often completed in hours. We communicate timeline expectations clearly throughout your project.

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: A full replacement in the material that suits your home.
services.text: We offer full roof replacement services for your home or business, using quality materials and advanced methods for long-term protection and appeal.
services.imageAlt: A roof mid-replacement with new underlayment down and the crew working
body: Most residential roof replacements take 1 to 3 days, depending on size, complexity and weather. We coordinate carefully to minimize disruption to your daily routine and communicate timeline expectations clearly from start to final inspection.

Average roof replacement in Houston costs around $12,000, though prices vary based on size, materials, complexity and the extent of the damage; metal and tile roofs average $20,000. We provide free, detailed estimates within 24 hours, and our transparent pricing includes materials, labor, permits and cleanup.
points: Asphalt, metal, tile and synthetic options
Manufacturer product warranties up to 30 years

faqs.q: How long does a typical roof installation take?
faqs.a: Most residential roof replacements take 1-3 days, depending on size, complexity, and weather conditions. We work efficiently while maintaining quality standards.

faqs.q: What warranties cover my new roof?
faqs.a: We stand behind our work with a 10-year workmanship warranty on installations and a 1-year warranty on repairs. Manufacturer product warranties extend up to 30 years, depending on the materials selected.

services.title: Roof Inspections
services.text: Our extensive roof inspection services identify potential issues before they become severe problems, with a full assessment of the roof's condition.
services.imageAlt: An inspector marking hail hits on a shingle roof
body: Annual inspections are recommended, especially after severe storms. Regular inspections identify minor issues before they become expensive problems, extend roof lifespan and maintain warranty coverage.

We offer free drone inspections, which give a comprehensive assessment without walking the roof surface. Our free 24-hour inspections provide honest assessments to help you make informed decisions about your home's protection.

An inspection covers the surface, for missing, cracked or curling shingles, discoloration, algae growth and granule loss; leak detection; the gutters and drainage; the flashing and seals around chimneys, vents and skylights; and the structural integrity of the framework. Every finding is documented with photos and detailed notes, and we never recommend a repair you do not need.
Beyond the annual inspection, Texas homeowners should schedule one at least twice a year, in spring and fall, with an additional inspection after any major storm.
points: Twice a year in spring and fall, and after any storm
Surface, leaks, gutters, flashing and structure
Findings documented with photos and notes

faqs.q: How often should I have my roof inspected?
faqs.a: Annual inspections are recommended, especially after severe storms. Regular inspections identify minor issues before they become expensive problems, extend roof lifespan, and maintain warranty coverage.

faqs.q: How quickly can you provide a roofing estimate?
faqs.a: We provide free estimates within 24 hours. Contact us to schedule your inspection and our team will assess your roof thoroughly, answer questions, and deliver a detailed, transparent estimate.

services.title: Asphalt Shingle Roofing
services.short: The most affordable roof for Houston's climate.
services.text: Asphalt shingle installation, the most affordable of the premium roofing materials we install, matched to your home's style and budget.
services.imageAlt: A roofer nailing down a new course of asphalt shingles
body: Houston's heat, humidity and storm activity demand durable materials. Asphalt shingles are the most affordable of the premium materials we install, and our experience helps us recommend the right line for your budget, home style and long-term performance needs.
We are affiliated with industry-leading manufacturers, which gives us access to premium materials, better warranties and competitive pricing.
points: Matched to Houston's heat, humidity and storms

services.title: Metal Roofing
services.short: Longevity and energy efficiency, for homes and businesses.
services.text: Metal roofing installed for longevity and energy efficiency, including standing seam systems for homes and commercial buildings.
body: Metal is the material we recommend when longevity and energy efficiency matter most. Metal and tile roofs average $20,000 in the Houston market, and we provide a free, detailed estimate within 24 hours so you can see the number before you decide.
We install standing seam metal roofing with hidden fasteners, corrugated metal roofing and metal roofing shingles in steel or aluminum. With proper installation, many metal roofs last 40 to 70 years.
We also install tile and synthetic materials such as Brava and Euroshield, and we are a certified Euroshield installer.
points: Standing seam metal roofing with hidden fasteners
Metal roofing shingles in steel or aluminum
Many metal roofs last 40 to 70 years

services.title: Slate Roofing
services.short: Natural and synthetic slate, installed, replaced and repaired.
services.text: Slate roofing installation, replacement and repair, in natural stone or synthetic slate, for homeowners who want exceptional longevity and timeless curb appeal.
body: Natural slate resists fire, moisture, insects and severe weather while holding its appearance for generations, and routinely lasts 75 to 100 years or longer with proper installation and maintenance. The initial investment is higher than asphalt shingles, so the extended lifespan is what makes it cost-effective over the long term.

Every installation begins with a thorough roof evaluation to confirm your home's structure can support the system, because Houston's humidity and storm exposure put the flashing and underlayment details at the center of how a slate roof performs. Synthetic slate gives many of the same visual benefits at less weight and lower installation cost, and we will tell you which of the two suits your property.

We also replace cracked or broken slate tiles, repair flashing, address leaks and restore damaged sections. Slate requires specialized techniques that differ from standard roofing systems, which is why the installation method, flashing detail and structural requirement all get settled before the first tile goes down.
points: Synthetic slate, lighter and lower cost
Resists fire, mold, rot and UV exposure

services.imageAlt: A fallen tree resting across the roof of a house after a storm
body: We guide homeowners through the entire insurance process, from documentation to claim submission. Our team inspects the damage thoroughly, provides detailed reports and communicates directly with adjusters when needed.
With 20+ years of experience handling insurance claims, we help maximize your coverage and minimize out-of-pocket costs for storm damage restoration.
points: Detailed damage reports for your insurer
Temporary solutions to stop further damage
Full restoration once the claim is approved

faqs.q: Do you help with insurance claims for roof damage?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We guide homeowners through the entire insurance process, from documentation to claim submission. Our team inspects damage thoroughly, provides detailed reports, and communicates directly with adjusters when needed.

services.title: Emergency Roof Repair
services.short: Same-day for daytime calls, next morning for night calls.
services.text: Storm damage, sudden leaks and urgent repairs cannot wait. We respond to roofing emergencies as quickly as possible.
services.imageAlt: A roofer prying up storm-damaged shingles during an urgent repair
body: We respond same-day for daytime calls and the next morning for nighttime emergencies. Our rapid response team assesses damage immediately and implements temporary solutions to prevent further damage while planning permanent repairs.

We have 24/7 emergency availability. The work covers storm and wind damage, leak detection and water intrusion, flashing, seam and penetration repairs, and emergency tarping: secure, professional temporary protection that stops the water until the permanent repair can be done.
Call (281) 694-4133 and tell us what you are seeing. We will tell you what to do until we get there.
points: Leak detection and water intrusion repair
Permanent repair planned from the same visit

faqs.q: Do you provide emergency roof repair services?
faqs.a: Yes. We respond to roofing emergencies as quickly as possible, same-day for daytime calls and next morning for nighttime emergencies.

services.title: Seamless Gutters
services.short: Custom-fit gutters, K-style gutters and gutter guards.
services.text: We install and replace seamless gutters to protect your home or business from water damage, custom-fit to your property for proper drainage and fewer leaks.
services.imageAlt: A white seamless gutter and downspout along a roof edge
body: Our systems are custom-fit for your property to ensure proper drainage, reduced leaks and long-term performance. We use high-quality materials and proven techniques so the water leaves the roof and the foundation alone.

We fabricate seamless gutters on site for a precise fit, which improves water flow and alignment and cuts the number of joints where leaks start. We also install sectional gutter systems, K-style profiles for high rainfall volume, and half-round and box gutters, which suit custom or historic buildings and large commercial roofs needing maximum capacity.
We install seamless gutters, K-style gutters, gutter guards and other gutter systems, averaging $2,500.
points: K-style gutters for high rainfall volume

faqs.q: Can you install gutters and siding?
faqs.a: Yes. Beyond roofing, we install seamless gutters, K-style gutters, gutter guards, and various gutter systems averaging $2,500. We also install vinyl, composite, stucco, wood, metal, fiber cement, Hardie Board, and LP SmartSide siding.

services.title: Ventilation & Solar Power
services.short: Solar-powered attic ventilation and solar installation.
services.text: We install attic ventilation systems that improve airflow, reduce heat and moisture buildup, and support a more comfortable, efficient home.
services.imageAlt: A solar-powered attic fan installed on a shingle roof
body: Houston heat and humidity build up in an attic and shorten the life of the roof above it. Solar-powered attic ventilation moves that air without adding to your electricity bill.

A solar attic fan is a self-contained unit mounted on the roof or gable, with a built-in panel that powers the fan directly: no wiring, no added electric bill and no need for a full solar power system. We size the fan to your attic's square footage, position it for maximum sun exposure, and flash and seal each mounting point to manufacturer specification so the installation protects the roof rather than creating a new leak point.

We also evaluate the ridge, soffit and gable vents already on the roof, because a fan only works alongside proper intake airflow, and we check panel exposure, fan operation and seal integrity as part of a regular roof inspection. Cactus Jax does not install whole-home solar electric systems; our work is attic ventilation products that use solar power to move air.
points: No wiring and no added electric bill
Fan sized to your attic and positioned for sun
Ridge, soffit and gable vent evaluation
Mounting points flashed to manufacturer spec

services.text: Exterior painting, siding and window installation, for a clean, durable finish and better weather resistance across the whole exterior.
services.imageAlt: A painter on a ladder working on the exterior of a house
body: We specialize in exterior painting to improve and protect your property's exterior, delivering a clean, durable finish that enhances curb appeal and long-term weather resistance.

We install vinyl, composite, stucco, wood, metal, fiber cement, Hardie Board and LP SmartSide siding, along with engineered wood and insulated siding systems, averaging $20,000 to $30,000. Windows are custom-fit to ensure a proper seal, better insulation and long-lasting performance in all seasons.

The window styles we install are double-hung, casement, awning, slider, picture and stationary, bay and bow, transom, and impact-resistant windows for storm-prone areas. Painting starts with preparation, because that is what the finish lasts on: power washing, scraping loose paint, sanding, replacing damaged trim, priming where needed and sealing cracks and gaps.
points: Exterior painting, with full surface preparation
Vinyl, composite, stucco, wood and metal siding
Fiber cement, Hardie Board and LP SmartSide
Engineered wood and insulated siding systems

We focus on quality workmanship and clean, reliable results, whether the job is an update or a full renovation.

services.title: Power Washing
services.short: Dirt, grime and buildup off exterior surfaces.
services.text: Professional power washing to remove dirt, grime and buildup from exterior surfaces, restoring curb appeal and maintaining the property's condition.

We wash driveways and walkways, decks and patios, wooden and vinyl fences, siding and exteriors, and roofs and gutters, using industry-leading equipment and eco-friendly cleaning solutions at the water pressure each surface can take.
Power washing is one of the services on our enquiry form, and we will quote it alongside roofing or exterior work on the same visit.
points: Removes dirt, grime, mold and mildew

about.title: A woman-owned, family-operated contractor in Houston
text: Located in Houston, TX, Cactus Jax Roofing & Construction is a woman-owned, family-operated general contractor specializing in commercial and multifamily roofing solutions. Backed by nearly two decades of industry experience, we are committed to delivering high-quality service with a focus on integrity, reliability and craftsmanship.

While we specialize in high-performance roofing systems, our expertise as general contractors extends to full-scale construction, exterior restoration and custom solutions tailored to each property's unique needs. From targeted repairs to large-scale renovations, we provide dependable service and efficient project execution designed to deliver lasting results and protect your investment.

Our journey began long before the company did, working hands-on in roles ranging from installation to project management. Founded with a vision to set a new standard in roofing, Cactus Jax was established on the principles of reliability, superior craftsmanship and unwavering customer care.

Our mission is to elevate the roofing industry by delivering unmatched quality, reliability and customer care. Your trust is our foundation, and we take pride in creating a sense of security for the people who choose us: when they hire us they are not just hiring a roofing contractor, they are partnering with a team that cares about their needs and concerns.
